run_ood_detection: run out-of-distribution detection on a neural network using a specified OOD dataset
run_with_custom_nn: run OOD detection with a custom neural network like densenet100 or wideresnet10
run_with_perturbation: run OOD detection with a custom perturbation magnitude for the neural network
run_with_temperature: run OOD detection with a custom temperature scaling value for softmax
run_on_gpu: run OOD detection on a specified GPU index for the neural network
